defectFoundAndFixed.description: The merged PR introduced a test with broken genome paths. The constants EXECUTION_LOOP_PATH and QUEUE_REPLENISHER_PATH pointed to ~/.openclaw/genome/core/loops/ but genome actually lives at ~/projects/genome/core/loops/. The test would always fail with ENOENT.
defectFoundAndFixed.fix: Changed path.join(process.env.HOME, '.openclaw/genome/...') to path.join(process.env.HOME, 'projects/genome/...'). Tests now pass: 6/6.

riskRationale: PR #1563 merged to main on 2026-05-11. Merge commit 5be5e056 is confirmed in main history. The orphan branch only modified a test file to reference new split module paths (execution-loop.js, queue-replenisher.js) instead of the old heartbeat-executor.js monolith. No production code changes. Broken paths in the merged test were patched in this investigation.
